readings: For films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99, compute for each rating the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration, ignoring missing values. Take the simple mean of those per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and the unrounded difference above the mean.

For films with replacement_cost greater than or equal to 20.99, compute for each rating the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration, ignoring missing values. Take the simple mean of those per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and the unrounded difference above the mean.

For films with replacement_cost strictly less than 20.99, compute for each rating the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration, ignoring missing values. Take the simple mean of those per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and the unrounded difference above the mean.

For films with replacement_cost less than or equal to 20.99, compute for each rating the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration, ignoring missing values. Take the simple mean of those per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and the unrounded difference above the mean.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_average
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rating_average) AS mean_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  rating,
  rating_average,
  rating_average - mean_average AS difference_above_mean
FROM rating_averages
CROSS JOIN overall_mean
WHERE rating_average > mean_average

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS mean_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.average_rate_per_day,
  r.average_rate_per_day - m.mean_average AS difference_above_mean
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE r.average_rate_per_day > m.mean_average;

WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS average_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost < 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS mean_average
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT
  per_rating.rating,
  per_rating.average_rate_per_day,
  per_rating.average_rate_per_day - overall.mean_average AS difference_above_mean
FROM per_rating
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE per_rating.average_rate_per_day > overall.mean_average

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS average_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS mean_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT rating,
       average_rate_per_day,
       average_rate_per_day - mean_average AS difference_above_mean
FROM rating_averages
CROSS JOIN overall_mean
WHERE average_rate_per_day > mean_average
